item.text:
Mixed, leaning positive on macro-policy correction but negative on political style and institutional autonomy. In 2024, Erdoğan’s team did move toward evidence-based stabilization, but the record still shows heavy presidential control, prior policy mistakes, and some targeted relief that looks more like political management than clean correction.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | IMF staff press release on Türkiye’s 2024 Article IV consultation | IMF | 2024-08-28 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/08/28/pr24311-turkiye-2024-article-iv-mission-press-release | IMF said the policy turnaround since mid-2023 tightened the macro mix, reduced crisis risks, improved reserves, and started lowering inflation. This is the clearest evidence of correction after earlier macro mistakes. | 5B.7, 5B.3 |
| Positive | Turkey central bank stuns market with 500-point rate hike to 50% | Reuters | 2024-03-21 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Turkey-central-bank-stuns-market-with-500-point-rate-hike-to-50--46253265/ | The CBRT’s pre-election hike was read by analysts as a sign of independence from political pressure. That supports an evidence-based response to inflation rather than slogan-driven denial. | 5B.7, 5B.2, 5B.3 |
| Positive | Türkiye 2024 Article IV Consultation: executive board conclusions | IMF | 2024-10-11 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/11/pr-24369-turkiye-imf-executive-board-concludes-2024-aiv-consultation | IMF directors said tax and expenditure measures strengthened credibility, reduced imbalances, and improved confidence, while urging tax-base broadening and subsidy reform. This supports a corrective, evidence-based policy posture. | 5B.7, 5B.3, 5B.4 |
| Negative | Turkey’s revolving door: Five years, six central bank chiefs | Reuters | 2024-02-05 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Turkey-s-revolving-door-Five-years-six-central-bank-chiefs-45882771/ | Reuters noted Erdoğan had fired the last four central bank governors and that the bank’s credibility had been badly damaged. That is strong evidence of political control over policy, not insulated correction. | 5B.7, 5B.2, 5B.3 |
| Negative | Turkey to lift minimum retirement pay, impose minimum corporate tax | Reuters | 2024-07-16 | https://theprint.in/world/turkey-to-lift-minimum-retirement-pay-impose-minimum-corporate-tax/2176793/ | The reported package reads more like targeted relief and political management than durable structural reform. It looks closer to popularity maintenance than a principled fix to earlier errors. | 5B.7, 5B.3, 5B.4 |
| Negative | Dark days for Turks as Erdogan atones for economic errors | Reuters | 2024-07-18 | https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/dark-days-for-turks-as-erdogan-atones-for-economic-errors-2024-07-18/ | Reuters described eroding living standards, years of punishing inflation, and a sharp credit clampdown. This supports the view that earlier policy mistakes were costly and that the correction came late. | 5B.7, 5B.3 |

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence of Erdoğan explicitly acknowledging economic mistakes in a candid way, nor clear evidence of systematic scapegoating in the economic policy record. The main positive evidence is the post-2023 stabilization turn; the main negative evidence is the long history of politically controlled monetary appointments and ad hoc relief measures.
